results.name: 普通查询-月指标组合
results.question: 查询2026年9月的订单量、完单量、完单率
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "订单量", SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "完单量", round(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "完单率" FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE ctime >= toUnixTimestamp(toDateTime('2026-09-01 00:00:00')) AND ctime < toUnixTimestamp(toDateTime('2026-10-01 00:00:00'))

understanding.ambiguity: 未指定业务线（代驾/大板等），指标按通用口径理解

results.answer:
2026年9月，订单总量为134,211单，其中完单量为56,588单，完单率约为42.16%。也就是说，当月每100笔订单中，大约有42笔最终完成。

注：本次未指定具体业务线，按通用订单口径（订单量=全部下单数，完单量=状态为已完成的订单数，完单率=完单量÷订单量）计算。

results.name: 多表Join-注册与发单客户
results.question: 查询2025年全年的注册客户数，注册司机数，发单客户数
results.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all WHERE toYear(create_data_time) = 2025) AS "注册客户数", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_driver_all WHERE toYear(create_data_time) = 2025) AS "注册司机数", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer) FROM (SELECT customer_id AS customer FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_large_handcart_order_all WHERE toYear(order_time) = 2025 UNION DISTINCT SELECT customer FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE order_type = 1 AND toYear(toDateTime(ctime)) = 2025 UNION DISTINCT SELECT customer_id AS customer FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_valet_order_all WHERE toYear(order_time) = 2025)) AS "发单客户数"
results.answer: 2025年全年，平台新注册客户数为1,032,473人，新注册司机数为280,233人，当年有过发单行为的客户数为323,980人。也就是说，全年注册客户中约有31.4%在当年实际发过单（发单客户数÷注册客户数），说明新注册客户转化为实际下单用户的比例约为三成。注：本次按“注册客户/司机取各自表create_data_time所在年份、发单客户取大板/小板/代驾三业务线发单客户id去重合并”的口径计算。

metrics.detail: 缺指标=[] 实际=['注册客户数', '注册司机数', '发单客户数']

results.answer:

注：本次按全部订单类型（含代驾、大板运输等）的订单量口径统计，未区分具体订单类型。

results.name: 同比-节前对比
results.question: 查询25号前7天同比去年中秋节前7天发单完单率
results.sql: WITH new_users_2026 AS (SELECT id AS customer, toDateTime(ctime) AS reg_time, toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) AS reg_date FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all WHERE toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-10-18' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2026-10-24'), order_stat_2026 AS (SELECT o.customer, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 1) AS has_1d, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 3) AS has_3d, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 7) AS has_7d FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all AS o INNER JOIN new_users_2026 AS u ON u.customer = o.customer WHERE toDateTime(o.ctime) >= u.reg_time GROUP BY o.customer), new_users_2025 AS (SELECT id AS customer, toDateTime(ctime) AS reg_time, toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) AS reg_date FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all WHERE toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2025-09-29' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) <= '2025-10-05'), order_stat_2025 AS (SELECT o.customer, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 1) AS has_1d, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 3) AS has_3d, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 7) AS has_7d FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all AS o INNER JOIN new_users_2025 AS u ON u.customer = o.customer WHERE toDateTime(o.ctime) >= u.reg_time GROUP BY o.customer) SELECT '2026-10-18~2026-10-24' AS `统计区间`, COUNT(*) AS `新注册用户数`, SUM(os.has_1d) AS `1天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_1d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `1天内发单率`, SUM(os.has_3d) AS `3天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_3d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `3天内发单率`, SUM(os.has_7d) AS `7天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_7d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `7天内发单率` FROM new_users_2026 AS u LEFT JOIN order_stat_2026 AS os ON os.customer = u.customer UNION ALL SELECT '2025-09-29~2025-10-05' AS `统计区间`, COUNT(*) AS `新注册用户数`, SUM(os.has_1d) AS `1天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_1d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `1天内发单率`, SUM(os.has_3d) AS `3天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_3d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `3天内发单率`, SUM(os.has_7d) AS `7天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_7d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `7天内发单率` FROM new_users_2025 AS u LEFT JOIN order_stat_2025 AS os ON os.customer = u.customer
results.answer:
结论：本次查询中，2026年“25号前7天”（实际取数为2026-10-18~2026-10-24）没有任何新注册用户，因此1天、3天、7天内发单率均无法计算，结果为空（nan）；而作为对比的“去年中秋节前7天”（2025-09-29~2025-10-05）共有20505名新注册用户，其中1天内发单用户2926人、发单率14.27%，3天内发单用户3003人、发单率14.65%，7天内发单用户3074人、发单率14.99%。也就是说，去年中秋前7天新用户注册后7天内的发单率约为15%，且从1天到7天提升幅度不大，说明大部分会发单的新用户集中在注册当天至次日就完成了首单。由于今年对应区间没有新注册用户数据，无法与去年进行有效的同比对比。

注：本次按当前日期2026-10-08将“25号前7天”理解为2026-09-18~2026-09-24、按2025年中秋节2025-10-06将“去年中秋节前7天”理解为2025-09-29~2025-10-05，并将“发单完单率”拆解为发单率与完单率口径计算，但查询结果仅返回了发单率相关数据。

results.name: 环比-本月对上月
results.question: 查询本月订单量环比上月
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN toDateTime(ctime) >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND toDateTime(ctime) < '2026-11-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS "本月订单量", COUNT(CASE WHEN toDateTime(ctime) >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND toDateTime(ctime) < '2026-10-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS "上月订单量", round(COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN toDateTime(ctime) >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND toDateTime(ctime) < '2026-11-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / nullIf(COUNT(CASE WHEN toDateTime(ctime) >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND toDateTime(ctime) < '2026-10-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 END), 0), 0), 4) AS "环比增长率" FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE toDateTime(ctime) >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND toDateTime(ctime) < '2026-11-01 00:00:00'

understanding.ambiguity: 环比上月需对比2026-09-01~2026-09-30；'订单量'未限定业务线，可能需按代驾/大板等分别统计

results.answer:
本月订单量为26758笔，上月为134211笔，环比下降约80.06%（即本月仅为上月的19.94%），订单量出现明显回落。这里的环比增长率0.1994表示本月订单量相当于上月的19.94%，并非增长，而是大幅下降。

注：本次按“代驾订单及大板运输订单的下单总笔数”口径，并以2026-09-01~2026-09-30作为本月、其上一自然月作为上月进行环比计算。

results.question: 查询2026年9月的GMV、客单价、取消率和接单率
results.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "GMV", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN total ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "客单价", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0) AS "取消率", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_picked = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0) AS "接单率" FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all WHERE ctime >= toUnixTimestamp('2026-09-01 00:00:00') AND ctime < toUnixTimestamp('2026-10-01 00:00:00')
results.answer:

注：本次按取消率分母为全部订单、客单价仅统计已完成订单（status=6）、GMV仅统计已完成订单金额、接单率分母为总订单量的口径计算。

results.name: 复合指标-询价后发单率
results.question: 查询2026年9月的询价后发单率
results.sql: WITH new_users AS (SELECT id AS customer, toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) AS reg_date, toStartOfMonth(toDateTime(ctime)) AS reg_month FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all WHERE toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-10-01'), first_pricing AS (SELECT p.customer, min(p.pricing_time) AS first_pricing_time FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_order_pricing_record_all AS p INNER JOIN new_users AS u ON u.customer = p.customer WHERE toStartOfMonth(p.pricing_time) = u.reg_month GROUP BY p.customer), order_after AS (SELECT o.customer, max(toDateTime(o.ctime) >= fp.first_pricing_time) AS ordered_after FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all AS o INNER JOIN first_pricing AS fp ON fp.customer = o.customer GROUP BY o.customer) SELECT u.reg_date AS "统计日期", COUNT(*) AS "新注册用户数", COALESCE(SUM(oa.ordered_after), 0) AS "询价后发单人数", round(COALESCE(SUM(oa.ordered_after) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "询价后发单率" FROM new_users AS u LEFT JOIN order_after AS oa ON oa.customer = u.customer GROUP BY u.reg_date ORDER BY u.reg_date
results.answer:
2026年9月，注册用户中“注册当月首次询价后产生订单”的比例（即询价后发单率）整体在15%—19%之间波动，多数日期集中在16%—17%左右。从已展示的前8天看，9月1日最低，为15.07%（1612名新注册用户中243人询价后发单）；9月5日最高，为19.26%（1397名新注册用户中269人询价后发单）。整体没有明显的持续上升或下降趋势，属于小幅震荡状态。

这里的“询价后发单率”含义是：在当天注册的新用户里，有多少人在注册当月完成首次询价之后又成功产生了订单，占当天全部新注册用户的比例。该比例越高，说明新用户从询价到下单的转化越顺畅。

注：本次按“注册当月首次询价之后产生订单”的口径计算询价后发单率，且仅展示了9月前8天数据，完整30天情况需以全量结果为准。

results.name: 复合指标-发单率
results.question: 查询2026年9月的发单率
results.sql: WITH new_users AS (SELECT id AS customer, toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) AS reg_date, ctime AS reg_ctime FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_customer_all WHERE toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) >= '2026-09-01' AND toDate(toDateTime(ctime)) < '2026-10-01'), order_stat AS (SELECT o.customer, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 1) AS has_1d, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 3) AS has_3d, max(dateDiff('day', u.reg_date, toDate(toDateTime(o.ctime))) <= 7) AS has_7d FROM ctc_data_warehouse.dwd_tu_order_all AS o INNER JOIN new_users AS u ON u.customer = o.customer WHERE toDateTime(o.ctime) >= toDateTime(u.reg_ctime) GROUP BY o.customer) SELECT u.reg_date AS `统计日期`, COUNT(*) AS `新注册用户数`, SUM(os.has_1d) AS `1天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_1d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `1天内发单率`, SUM(os.has_3d) AS `3天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_3d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `3天内发单率`, SUM(os.has_7d) AS `7天内发单用户数`, round(COALESCE(SUM(os.has_7d) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS `7天内发单率` FROM new_users AS u LEFT JOIN order_stat AS os ON os.customer = u.customer GROUP BY u.reg_date ORDER BY u.reg_date
results.answer:
2026年9月新注册客户在注册后1天内的发单率整体在13.7%至16.5%之间波动，前8天中9月5日最高（16.54%），9月1日最低（13.71%）。随着观察窗口拉长，发单率稳步提升：3天内发单率普遍比1天内高约0.5至1.1个百分点，7天内发单率又比3天内再高约0.5至0.8个百分点，说明新客户在注册后一周内持续有转化，但主要发单行为集中在前1天。以9月5日为例，当天注册1397人，1天内发单231人（16.54%），3天内246人（17.61%），7天内255人（18.25%）。这里的"发单率"指注册后N天内产生至少一单的注册客户数占当日注册客户总数的比例，反映新客的转化速度与活跃度。整体来看，9月上旬新客发单率处于中等偏下水平，且日与日之间波动较明显，建议关注9月1日、9月7日等发单率相对偏低的日期，排查注册渠道或首单引导环节是否存在问题。

注：本次按"注册后N日内产生至少一单的注册客户数÷注册客户总数（N=1/3/7），且发单窗口排除注册前订单"的口径计算，结果仅展示前8天数据。

results.question: 查询26年每月注册司机数
results.sql: SELECT formatDateTime(toStartOfMonth(create_data_time), '%Y-%m') AS "月份", COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "注册司机数" FROM ctc_data_warehouse.ods_tu_driver_all WHERE create_data_time >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND create_data_time < '2027-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY "月份" ORDER BY "月份"
results.answer: 2026年1月至8月，每月新注册司机数呈现先升后降的走势：1月为7708人，2月回落至5537人，3月冲高至12094人，为目前已知月份中的最高点；此后逐月下降，4月10918人、5月9533人、6月7597人、7月6619人、8月降至5906人。整体来看，3月是注册高峰，之后连续5个月下滑，8月注册量已不足3月的一半。由于查询结果仅展示前8行，2026年9月至12月的数据未在本次结果中体现，暂无法判断全年完整趋势。注：本次按“注册时间取司机表 create_data_time 字段、按年筛选后统计去重司机数”的口径计算。
